pages.text: Use a Soul Filter’s editor with a filled Soul Vial as a sample. Choose the allowed or denied mobs, then install the filter in a compatible obelisk. Use the range view to confirm where the rule applies.

pages.title: Animal and Monster
pages.text: Bind a creature soul such as a Cow into a Soularium Grinding Ball for an Animal Token. A monster soul with the same ball makes a Monster Token. Both cost 12,800 FE and one level’s worth of XP Juice.

pages.title: Player Token
pages.text: Use a Villager Soul Vial and a Dark Steel Grinding Ball to make a Player Token. The stock cost is 12,800 FE and one level’s worth of XP Juice. Use tokens in the matching fused glass recipes.
